<script type="text/x-server-plugin">
/*
  monaco-collab agent bridge — authoritative journal + probe registry.

  EVERYTHING HERE IS PUBLIC SOURCE. It stores no secrets and trusts no client:
  it only sequences, bounds, and persists a small event log plus the latest
  probe digest/heartbeat counters, so an external reader (the AI helper) can
  verify liveness through the socket. Durable memory is the `state` bytes.

  Layout v2 — a FIXED-SLOT RING so appending is O(1) (never re-serialises the
  whole log, unlike v1). `state` is 50 MiB and zero-initialised.
    HEADER (32 bytes)
      [0]      version
      [1..4]   beats    u32
      [5..8]   seq      u32
      [9..24]  digest   16 raw bytes decoded from hex text
      [25..26] count    u16  (valid slots in the ring)
      [27..28] cursor   u16  (next slot index to write)
      [29..30] probeLen u16
      [31]     reserved
    JOURNAL ring: JOURNAL_OFF + i*SLOT, each slot = len(u16) + utf8(JSON entry)
    PROBE region: PROBE_OFF, raw utf8 probe source (probeLen bytes)
*/
(() => {
  const VERSION = 2;
  const HEADER = 32;
  const MAX_JOURNAL = 400;
  const SLOT = 320;
  const JOURNAL_OFF = HEADER;                 // 32
  const PROBE_OFF = JOURNAL_OFF + MAX_JOURNAL * SLOT;
  const PROBE_MAX = 2048;

  function rd32(o) { return state[o] * 16777216 + (state[o + 1] << 16) + (state[o + 2] << 8) + state[o + 3]; }
  function wr32(o, v) { v = v >>> 0; state[o] = v >>> 24; state[o + 1] = (v >>> 16) & 255; state[o + 2] = (v >>> 8) & 255; state[o + 3] = v & 255; }
  function rd16(o) { return (state[o] << 8) | state[o + 1]; }
  function wr16(o, v) { state[o] = (v >>> 8) & 255; state[o + 1] = v & 255; }

  function utf8Encode(str) {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
      let c = str.charCodeAt(i);
      if (c < 0x80) out.push(c);
      else if (c < 0x800) out.push(0xc0 | (c >> 6), 0x80 | (c & 63));
      else if (c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff && i + 1 < str.length) {
        const c2 = str.charCodeAt(i + 1);
        if (c2 >= 0xdc00 && c2 <= 0xdfff) {
          const cp = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (c2 - 0xdc00);
          out.push(0xf0 | (cp >> 18), 0x80 | ((cp >> 12) & 63), 0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (cp & 63));
          i++;
        } else out.push(0xe0 | (c >> 12), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
      } else out.push(0xe0 | (c >> 12), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    }
    return out;
  }
  function utf8Decode(bytes, start, end) {
    let s = "";
    let chunk = [];
    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
      const b = bytes[i];
      let cp;
      if (b < 0x80) { cp = b; }
      else if (b < 0xe0) { cp = ((b & 31) << 6) | (bytes[++i] & 63); }
      else if (b < 0xf0) { cp = ((b & 15) << 12) | ((bytes[++i] & 63) << 6) | (bytes[++i] & 63); }
      else { cp = ((b & 7) << 18) | ((bytes[++i] & 63) << 12) | ((bytes[++i] & 63) << 6) | (bytes[++i] & 63); }
      if (cp > 0xffff) { cp -= 0x10000; chunk.push(0xd800 + (cp >> 10), 0xdc00 + (cp & 1023)); }
      else chunk.push(cp);
      if (chunk.length >= 512) { s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk); chunk = []; }
    }
    if (chunk.length) s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk);
    return s;
  }

  // ---------- durable caches (rebuilt from `state`) ----------
  let journal = [];
  let beats = 0, seq = 0, cursor = 0, count = 0;
  let probeSrc = "", lastDigest = "";

  function readState() {
    journal = [];
    if (state[0] !== VERSION) return;
    beats = rd32(1);
    seq = rd32(5);
    let hex = "";
    for (let i = 9; i < 25; i++) hex += (state[i] < 16 ? "0" : "") + state[i].toString(16);
    lastDigest = hex;
    count = rd16(25);
    cursor = rd16(27);
    const plen = rd16(29);
    probeSrc = (plen > 0 && plen <= PROBE_MAX) ? utf8Decode(state, PROBE_OFF, PROBE_OFF + plen) : "";
    const n = Math.min(count, MAX_JOURNAL);
    const start = (cursor - n + MAX_JOURNAL * 2) % MAX_JOURNAL;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const slot = JOURNAL_OFF + ((start + i) % MAX_JOURNAL) * SLOT;
      const len = rd16(slot);
      if (len > 0 && len + 2 <= SLOT) {
        let obj = null;
        try { obj = JSON.parse(utf8Decode(state, slot + 2, slot + 2 + len)); } catch (e) {}
        if (obj) journal.push(obj);
      }
    }
  }

  function writeHeader() {
    state[0] = VERSION;
    wr32(1, beats);
    wr32(5, seq);
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) state[9 + i] = 0;
    const hex = lastDigest.replace(/[^0-9a-f]/gi, "").slice(0, 32);
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < hex.length; i += 2) state[9 + (i >> 1)] = parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16) || 0;
  }

  function writeProbe() {
    const bytes = utf8Encode(probeSrc);
    const len = Math.min(bytes.length, PROBE_MAX);
    wr16(29, len);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) state[PROBE_OFF + i] = bytes[i];
  }

  function append(entry) {
    const str = JSON.stringify(entry);
    const bytes = utf8Encode(str);
    if (bytes.length + 2 <= SLOT) {
      const slot = JOURNAL_OFF + cursor * SLOT;
      wr16(slot, bytes.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) state[slot + 2 + i] = bytes[i];
      cursor = (cursor + 1) % MAX_JOURNAL;
      count = Math.min(count + 1, MAX_JOURNAL);
      wr16(25, count);
      wr16(27, cursor);
    }
    journal.push(entry);
    if (journal.length > MAX_JOURNAL) journal = journal.slice(-MAX_JOURNAL);
    writeHeader();
    pubsub.publish("bridge", str);
  }

  function log(kind, obj) {
    seq++;
    append(Object.assign({ t: kind, at: Date.now(), seq }, obj));
  }

  // ---------- minimal per-connection rate limiting ----------
  const hits = new Map();
  const windows = new Map();
  function allow(conn, max) {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (windows.get(conn.id) !== (now / 1000) | 0) { windows.set(conn.id, (now / 1000) | 0); hits.set(conn.id, 0); }
    const n = (hits.get(conn.id) || 0) + 1;
    hits.set(conn.id, n);
    return n <= max;
  }
  function safe(fn) { try { return fn(); } catch (e) { return null; } }

  readState();

  function snapshot() {
    return {
      t: "snapshot", at: Date.now(), version: VERSION, beats, seq,
      digest: lastDigest, probe: probeSrc,
      journal: journal.slice(-120),
    };
  }

  self.onopen = ({ conn }) => {
    conn.subscribe("bridge");
    safe(() => conn.send(JSON.stringify(snapshot())));
  };

  self.onclose = ({ conn }) => { hits.delete(conn.id); windows.delete(conn.id); };

  const HANDLERS = {
    hello: (conn) => safe(() => conn.send(JSON.stringify(snapshot()))),
    beat: (conn, m) => {
      beats++;
      lastDigest = String(m.digest || lastDigest).slice(0, 32);
      if (beats % 20 === 0) log("beat", { n: beats, digest: lastDigest, probeMs: m.probeMs | 0, results: m.results || {} });
      else writeHeader();
    },
    say: (conn, m) => log("say", { by: String(m.by || "anon").slice(0, 24), text: String(m.text || "").slice(0, 1200), cid: String(m.cid || "").slice(0, 40) }),
    task: (conn, m) => log("task", { id: String(m.id || ("t" + seq)).slice(0, 40), state: String(m.state || "open").slice(0, 16), text: String(m.text || "").slice(0, 800), by: String(m.by || "user").slice(0, 24) }),
    "probe:set": (conn, m) => { probeSrc = String(m.src || "").slice(0, PROBE_MAX); writeProbe(); log("probe:set", { len: probeSrc.length, by: String(m.by || "anon").slice(0, 24) }); },
    ping: (conn) => safe(() => conn.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "pong", at: Date.now(), beats }))),
  };

  self.onmessage = ({ conn, data }) => {
    if (typeof data !== "string" || data.length > 8000) return;
    if (!allow(conn, 120)) return;
    let m;
    try { m = JSON.parse(data); } catch (e) { return; }
    if (!m || typeof m.t !== "string") return;
    const h = HANDLERS[m.t];
    if (h) safe(() => h(conn, m));
  };

  self.rpc = {
    snapshot() { return JSON.stringify(snapshot()); },
    journal({ conn }, data) {
      const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, parseInt(data, 10) || 60));
      return JSON.stringify({ t: "journal", at: Date.now(), entries: journal.slice(-n) });
    },
    probe() { return JSON.stringify({ t: "probe", at: Date.now(), src: probeSrc, digest: lastDigest, beats }); },
    reset() {
      journal = []; beats = 0; seq = 0; cursor = 0; count = 0; lastDigest = ""; probeSrc = "";
      writeHeader(); wr16(25, 0); wr16(27, 0); writeProbe();
      return JSON.stringify({ t: "reset", at: Date.now() });
    },
  };
})();
</script>

/* Touchscreen receiver for this page itself (canceled-touchscreen-api-plugin):
   lets a TouchBridge surface drive the app chrome when this generator is the
   bridge target. Same protocol as the preview-doc receiver. */
(function () {
  if (window.__touchRecvOn) return; window.__touchRecvOn = true;
  window.addEventListener("message", function (e) {
    var m = e.data; if (!m || !m.__touchBridge) return;
    var el = (m.x !== undefined) ? document.elementFromPoint(window.innerWidth * m.x / 100, window.innerHeight * m.y / 100) : (document.activeElement || document.body);
    if (!el) return;
    var b = m.button === "middle" ? 1 : m.button === "right" ? 2 : 0;
    var px = (m.x !== undefined) ? window.innerWidth * m.x / 100 : 0, py = (m.y !== undefined) ? window.innerHeight * m.y / 100 : 0;
    function ev(t, i) { try { el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(t, i)); } catch (x) {} }
    var i = { button: b, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: px, clientY: py };
    if (m.kind === "mousedown" || m.kind === "click") ev("mousedown", i);
    if (m.kind === "mouseup" || m.kind === "click") ev("mouseup", i);
    if (m.kind === "click") { ev("click", i); try { el.focus(); } catch (x) {} }
    else if (m.kind === "wheel") { try { window.scrollBy(0, m.dy || 100); } catch (x) {} }
    else if (m.kind === "type") { var a = document.activeElement; if (a && "value" in a) { a.value = (a.value || "") + m.text; a.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); } }
    else if (m.kind === "key") { (document.activeElement || document.body).dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: m.key, bubbles: true })); }
  });
})();
</script>

/* ============================ diff ============================ */
function lcsRows(A, B) {
  const n = A.length, m = B.length;
  const rows = [];
  if ((n + 1) * (m + 1) > 4_000_000) {
    for (const l of A) rows.push({ t: "del", a: l, an: 0, bn: null });
    for (const l of B) rows.push({ t: "add", a: l, an: null, bn: 0 });
    return rows;
  }
  const w = m + 1;
  const dp = new Int32Array((n + 1) * w);
  for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    for (let j = m - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      dp[i * w + j] = A[i] === B[j] ? dp[(i + 1) * w + j + 1] + 1 : Math.max(dp[(i + 1) * w + j], dp[i * w + j + 1]);
    }
  }
  let i = 0, j = 0, an = 1, bn = 1;
  while (i < n && j < m) {
    if (A[i] === B[j]) { rows.push({ t: "ctx", a: A[i], an: an++, bn: bn++ }); i++; j++; }
    else if (dp[(i + 1) * w + j] >= dp[i * w + j + 1]) { rows.push({ t: "del", a: A[i], an: an++, bn: null }); i++; }
    else { rows.push({ t: "add", a: B[j], an: null, bn: bn++ }); j++; }
  }
  while (i < n) rows.push({ t: "del", a: A[i++], an: an++, bn: null });
  while (j < m) rows.push({ t: "add", a: B[j++], an: null, bn: bn++ });
  return rows;
}
function renderDiffHTML(file, rev) {
  const rows = lcsRows(rev.text.split("\n"), file.text.split("\n"));
  const body = rows.map((r) => {
    const cls = r.t === "add" ? "add" : r.t === "del" ? "del" : "ctx";
    const sign = r.t === "add" ? "+" : r.t === "del" ? "-" : " ";
    return '<div class="drow ' + cls + '"><span class="dln">' + (r.an == null ? "" : r.an) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="dln">' + (r.bn == null ? "" : r.bn) + '</span><span class="dsign">' + sign + '</span>' +
      '<span class="dtx">' + esc(r.a) + '</span></div>';
  }).join("");
  return '<div class="diffview">' + body + '</div>';
}

function onTermData(data) {

  if (data === "\r" || data === "\n") return void submitLine();
  if (data.startsWith("\x1b")) return void handleEscape(data);
  switch (data) {
    case "\x7f": case "\b":
      if (ptyState.cursor > 0) { ptyState.line = ptyState.line.slice(0, ptyState.cursor - 1) + ptyState.line.slice(ptyState.cursor); ptyState.cursor--; }
      return void redrawLine();
    case "\x03": ptyState.line = ""; ptyState.cursor = 0; termWriteln("^C"); return void prompt();
    case "\x0c": return void redrawAll();
    case "\x15": ptyState.line = ptyState.line.slice(ptyState.cursor); ptyState.cursor = 0; return void redrawLine();
    case "\x0b": ptyState.line = ptyState.line.slice(0, ptyState.cursor); return void redrawLine();
    case "\x01": ptyState.cursor = 0; return void redrawLine();
    case "\x05": ptyState.cursor = ptyState.line.length; return void redrawLine();
    case "\x17": {
      const left = ptyState.line.slice(0, ptyState.cursor).replace(/\S+\s*$/, "");
      ptyState.line = left + ptyState.line.slice(ptyState.cursor);
      ptyState.cursor = left.length;
      return void redrawLine();
    }
    case "\t": return void complete();
    case "\x04":
      if (ptyState.mode === "repl") { ptyState.mode = "shell"; termWriteln(""); prompt(); }
      return;
    default: break;
  }
  const clean = [...String(data)].filter((ch) => ch >= " ").join("");
  if (!clean) return;
  ptyState.line = ptyState.line.slice(0, ptyState.cursor) + clean + ptyState.line.slice(ptyState.cursor);
  ptyState.cursor += clean.length;

    case "\x1b[D": if (ptyState.cursor > 0) { ptyState.cursor--; redrawLine(); } return;
    case "\x1b[H": case "\x1b[1~": ptyState.cursor = 0; redrawLine(); return;
    case "\x1b[F": case "\x1b[4~": ptyState.cursor = ptyState.line.length; redrawLine(); return;
    case "\x1b[3~": if (ptyState.cursor < ptyState.line.length) { ptyState.line = ptyState.line.slice(0, ptyState.cursor) + ptyState.line.slice(ptyState.cursor + 1); redrawLine(); } return;

function histMove(dir) {

    if (ptyState.hIdx > 0) ptyState.hIdx--;
  } else {
    if (ptyState.hIdx === -1) return;
    if (ptyState.hIdx < ptyState.history.length - 1) ptyState.hIdx++;
    else { ptyState.hIdx = -1; ptyState.line = ptyState.draft; ptyState.cursor = ptyState.line.length; return void redrawLine(); }
  }

function complete() {
  const upto = ptyState.line.slice(0, ptyState.cursor);
  const tok = upto.split(/\s+/);
  const cur = tok[tok.length - 1] || "";
  const first = tok.length <= 1 && !upto.endsWith(" ");
  const cands = first ? Object.keys(COMMANDS) : state.files.map((f) => f.name);
  const matches = cands.filter((c) => c.startsWith(cur));
  if (!matches.length) return;
  if (matches.length === 1) {
    const ins = matches[0].slice(cur.length) + (first ? " " : "");
    ptyState.line = upto + ins + ptyState.line.slice(ptyState.cursor);
    ptyState.cursor += ins.length;
    redrawLine();

  }
  termWriteln("");
  termWriteln(matches.join("   "));
  redrawLine();

async function submitLine() {

/* ---------- shell parsing ---------- */
function tokenize(str) {
  const out = []; let cur = ""; let q = null; let had = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    const ch = str[i];
    if (q) {
      if (ch === "\\" && q === '"' && i + 1 < str.length) cur += str[++i];
      else if (ch === q) q = null;
      else cur += ch;
    } else if (ch === "'" || ch === '"') { q = ch; had = true; }
    else if (/\s/.test(ch)) { if (cur !== "" || had) { out.push(cur); cur = ""; had = false; } }
    else cur += ch;
  }
  if (cur !== "" || had) out.push(cur);
  return out;
}
function splitTop(str, sep) {
  const parts = []; let cur = ""; let q = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    const ch = str[i];
    if (q) { if (ch === "\\" && q === '"') { cur += ch + (str[++i] || ""); } else { if (ch === q) q = null; cur += ch; } }
    else if (ch === "'" || ch === '"') { q = ch; cur += ch; }
    else if (ch === sep) { parts.push(cur); cur = ""; }
    else cur += ch;
  }
  parts.push(cur);
  return parts;
}
const escapeRegExp = (s) => String(s).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

async function runShellLine(line, io) {
  const segs = splitTop(line, "|").map((s) => s.trim()).filter((s) => s !== "");
  if (!segs.length) return;
  let stdin;
  for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
    const isLast = i === segs.length - 1;
    let tokens = tokenize(segs[i]);
    let redirect = null;
    if (isLast) {
      const j = tokens.findIndex((t, k) => (t === ">" || t === ">>") && k > 0);
      if (j > -1 && tokens[j + 1]) { redirect = { op: tokens[j], file: tokens[j + 1] }; tokens = tokens.slice(0, j); }
    }
    if (!tokens.length) return io.err("syntax error");
    const name = tokens[0], args = tokens.slice(1);
    const rawArgs = segs[i].replace(/^\s*("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)\s*/, "");
    const cmd = COMMANDS[name] || COMMANDS[Object.keys(COMMANDS).find((k) => COMMANDS[k].aliases && COMMANDS[k].aliases.includes(name))];
    if (!cmd) return io.err("collab: command not found: " + name + "  (try 'help')");
    const sink = { out: io.out, raw: io.raw, err: io.err, stdin, rawArgs };
    if (!isLast) {
      const lines = [];
      sink.out = (s) => { if (s != null) lines.push(String(s)); };
      sink.raw = (s) => { lines.push(crlf(s).replace(/\r\n$/, "")); };
      await safeRun(cmd, args, sink);
      stdin = lines.join("\n");
    } else if (redirect) {
      const lines = [];
      sink.out = (s) => { if (s != null) lines.push(String(s)); };
      sink.raw = (s) => { lines.push(crlf(s).replace(/\r\n$/, "")); };
      await safeRun(cmd, args, sink);
      const body = lines.join("\n") + "\n";
      await writeOrCreate(redirect.file, body, redirect.op === ">>");
      io.out(A.dim + "→ " + (redirect.op === ">>" ? "appended" : "wrote") + " " + body.length + " bytes to " + redirect.file + A.reset);
    } else {
      await safeRun(cmd, args, sink);
    }
  }
}
async function safeRun(cmd, args, io) {
  try { await cmd.run.call(cmd, args, io); }
  catch (e) { io.err("collab: " + ((e && e.message) || e)); }
}

function elementToDom(node) {
  if (node.type !== "element") return null;
  const start = node.namedChildren.find((c) => c.type === "start_tag");
  const tagNode = start && start.namedChildren.find((c) => c.type === "tag_name");
  const tag = (tagNode && tagNode.text) || "div";
  const attrs = {};
  if (start) {
    for (const a of start.namedChildren.filter((c) => c.type === "attribute")) {
      const n = a.namedChildren.find((c) => c.type === "attribute_name");
      const v = a.namedChildren.find((c) => c.type === "quoted_attribute_value" || c.type === "attribute_value");
      attrs[(n && n.text) || "attr"] = v ? (v.text || "").replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "") : "";
    }
  }
  const children = [];
  for (const c of node.namedChildren) {
    if (c === start || c.type === "end_tag") continue;
    if (c.type === "element") { const d = elementToDom(c); if (d) children.push(d); }
    else if (c.type === "comment") children.push("<!--" + c.text + "-->");
    else if (c.type === "text" || c.type === "raw_text") children.push(c.text);
  }
  return { tag, attrs, children };
}

const RENDER_WORKER_SRC = [

'let model = { status: "offline", beats: 0, digest: "", probeMs: 0, messages: [], streaming: null, results: {}, theme: "dark" };',
'const PAD = 10, LH = 15;',
'function C() { return model.theme === "light"',
'  ? { bg: "#ffffff", hdr: "#f3f3f3", line: "#e2e2e2", txt: "#1f1f1f", mute: "#767676", user: "#005fb8", ai: "#0f7b3f", helper: "#7c3aed", bubble: "#f2f2f2", ubub: "#dbeafe" }',

'  ctx.fillStyle = dot; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W - PAD - 12 - tw - 10, 13, 4, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();',
'  ctx.textAlign = "left";',

'  const top = 30, bottom = H - 18;',

const bridge = {
  socket: null, conn: "offline", beats: 0, seq: 0, digest: "", probeMs: 0,
  probeSrc: "", results: {}, journal: [], chat: [], seen: new Set(),
  runner: null, renderer: null, ready: null, running: false, timer: null,
  nextRetry: 1500, execs: 0, lastBeatAt: 0, lastError: "",
};

function workerUrl(src) { return URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src], { type: "text/javascript" })); }

function updateAgentStatus() {
  const el = document.getElementById("agentStatus");
  if (el) el.textContent = "bridge: " + bridge.conn + " · beats " + bridge.beats;
}

function agentModel() {
  return {
    status: bridge.conn, beats: bridge.beats, digest: bridge.digest, probeMs: bridge.probeMs,
    messages: bridge.chat.slice(-60), streaming: bridge.streaming || null,
    results: bridge.results, theme: state.theme,
  };
}

function renderAgent() { if (bridge.renderer) bridge.renderer.postMessage({ t: "state", model: agentModel() }); }

function resizeAgent() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById("agentCanvasWrap");
  const cvs = document.getElementById("agentCanvas");
  if (!wrap || !cvs || !bridge.renderer) return;
  const dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
  const w = Math.max(1, wrap.clientWidth), h = Math.max(1, wrap.clientHeight);
  if (cvs.width !== Math.round(w * dpr) || cvs.height !== Math.round(h * dpr)) { cvs.width = Math.round(w * dpr); cvs.height = Math.round(h * dpr); }
  bridge.renderer.postMessage({ t: "resize", w: w, h: h, dpr: dpr });
}

function ensureAgent() {
  if (bridge.ready) return bridge.ready;
  bridge.ready = (async () => {
    bridge.runner = new Worker(workerUrl(RUNNER_WORKER_SRC));
    bridge.runner.onmessage = (e) => {
      const m = e.data || {};
      const p = bridge.inflight && bridge.inflight.get(m.id);
      if (!p) return;
      bridge.inflight.delete(m.id);
      m.ok ? p.resolve(m) : p.reject(new Error(m.error || "worker error"));
    };
    bridge.inflight = new Map();
    bridge.renderer = new Worker(workerUrl(RENDER_WORKER_SRC));
    bridge.renderer.onmessage = (e) => {
      const m = e.data || {};
      if (m.t === "frame" && bridge.bitmapCtx) { bridge.renderSize = { w: m.w, h: m.h }; try { bridge.bitmapCtx.transferFromImageBitmap(m.bmp); } catch (err) {} }
    };
    const cvs = document.getElementById("agentCanvas");
    bridge.bitmapCtx = cvs.getContext("bitmaprenderer");
    const bmpCanvas = new OffscreenCanvas(1, 1);
    bridge.renderer.postMessage({ t: "init", canvas: bmpCanvas }, [bmpCanvas]);
    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(() => resizeAgent()).observe(document.getElementById("agentCanvasWrap"));
    resizeAgent();
    renderAgent();
    return true;
  })();
  return bridge.ready;
}

const runnerId = { n: 0 };
function runnerRun(cmd, args) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!bridge.runner) return reject(new Error("runner worker not ready"));
    const id = "r" + (++runnerId.n);
    bridge.inflight.set(id, { resolve: resolve, reject: reject });
    Promise.resolve(ensureAgent()).then(() => bridge.runner.postMessage({ t: "run", id: id, cmd: cmd, args: args }));
    setTimeout(() => { if (bridge.inflight.has(id)) { bridge.inflight.delete(id); reject(new Error("worker timeout")); } }, 12000);
  });
}

/* ---------- Function-constructor probe ---------- */
function defaultProbeSrc() {
  return [
    "const f = (window.collab && collab.list) ? collab.list().length : -1;",
    "return {",
    "  ok: true,",
    "  files: f,",
    "  beats: window.__agentBridge ? window.__agentBridge.beats : -1,",
    "  execs: window.__agentBridge ? window.__agentBridge.execs : -1,",
    "  ctor: [].constructor.constructor.name,",
    "  href: location.href.length,",
    "};",
  ].join("\n");
}
function fnv1a(str) {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { h ^= str.charCodeAt(i); h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0; }
  return h.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}
function compileProbe(src) {
  const maker = new Function("ctx", "return (function(){ " + src + "\n });");
  const fn = maker.call(null, window);
  if (typeof fn !== "function") throw new Error("probe did not compile to a function");
  return fn;
}
function runProbe() {
  const src = bridge.probeSrc || defaultProbeSrc();
  bridge.probeSrc = src;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  let out, err = null;
  try { out = compileProbe(src)(); }
  catch (e) { err = String((e && e.message) || e); out = { ok: false, error: err }; }
  const ms = Math.round(performance.now() - t0);
  const json = JSON.stringify(out);
  return { ok: !err, ms: ms, digest: fnv1a(json), output: out, error: err };
}

function pgrepSnapshot() {
  try { return processList().map((p) => p.name + ":" + p.state); } catch (e) { return []; }
}

/* ---------- the heartbeat battery: pgrep curl repl wasmdom ---------- */
async function runBeat(reason) {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const probe = runProbe();
  bridge.beats++;
  bridge.probeMs = probe.ms;
  bridge.digest = probe.digest;
  bridge.execs++;
  const url = BRIDGE_CFG.curlProbeUrl;
  const html = '<div id="beat" class="probe"><p>heartbeat ' + bridge.beats + '</p></div>';
  const code = "[].constructor.constructor('return 6*7')()";
  let wres = null, werr = "";
  try { wres = await runnerRun("wasmdom", { html: html }); }
  catch (e) { werr = String((e && e.message) || e); }
  let curlRes = null, replRes = null;
  try { curlRes = await runnerRun("curl", { url: url }); } catch (e) { curlRes = { ok: false, error: String((e && e.message) || e) }; }
  try { replRes = await runnerRun("repl", { code: code }); } catch (e) { replRes = { ok: false, error: String((e && e.message) || e) }; }
  const results = {
    pgrep: (function () { try { return processList().length; } catch (e) { return -1; } })(),
    curl: curlRes.ok ? (curlRes.result.status + "/" + curlRes.result.bytes + "B") : "err",
    repl: replRes.ok ? String(replRes.result.value) : "err",
    wasmdom: wres && wres.ok ? wres.result.nodes : "err",
    workerMs: wres ? wres.ms : -1,
  };
  bridge.results = results;
  bridge.lastBeatAt = Date.now();
  bridge.lastError = werr || "";
  publish({ t: "beat", n: bridge.beats, digest: probe.digest, probeMs: probe.ms, results: results, reason: reason || "tick" });
  renderAgent();
  updateAgentStatus();
  return { probe: probe, results: results, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) };
}

/* ---------- socket ---------- */
function publish(obj) {
  if (bridge.socket && bridge.socket.readyState === 1) {
    try { bridge.socket.send(JSON.stringify(obj)); } catch (e) {}
  }
}

function handleBridgeMessage(m) {
  if (!m || typeof m.t !== "string") return;
  if (m.t === "snapshot") {
    bridge.beats = Math.max(bridge.beats, m.beats || 0);
    bridge.seq = Math.max(bridge.seq, m.seq || 0);
    if (m.digest) bridge.digest = m.digest;
    if (m.probe && !bridge.probeSrc) { try { compileProbe(m.probe); bridge.probeSrc = m.probe; sSet("bridge:probe", m.probe); } catch (e) {} }
    bridge.journal = (m.journal || []).slice(-BRIDGE_CFG.maxJournal);
    for (const e of m.journal || []) { if (e && e.t === "say") ingestSay(e); }
    renderAgent();
    return;
  }
  if (m.t === "say") { ingestSay(m); return; }
  if (m.t === "beat") { bridge.beats = Math.max(bridge.beats, m.n || 0); if (m.digest) bridge.digest = m.digest; renderAgent(); updateAgentStatus(); return; }
  if (m.t === "probe:set" || m.t === "probe" || m.t === "task" || m.t === "reset") { bridge.journal.push(m); renderAgent(); return; }
  if (m.t === "pong") return;
}

function ingestSay(m) {
  if (m.seq != null && bridge.seen.has(m.seq)) return;
  if (m.seq != null) bridge.seen.add(m.seq);
  if (m.cid) {
    const mine = bridge.chat.find((c) => c.cid === m.cid);
    if (mine) { mine.seq = m.seq; bridge.journal.push(m); return; }
  }
  bridge.journal.push(m);
  if (bridge.journal.length > BRIDGE_CFG.maxJournal) bridge.journal = bridge.journal.slice(-BRIDGE_CFG.maxJournal);
  if (m.by === "user" || m.by === "ai-helper" || m.by === "ai") {
    if (bridge.chat.some((c) => c.seq === m.seq)) return;
    bridge.chat.push({ seq: m.seq, by: m.by, text: m.text, at: m.at || Date.now() });
    renderAgent();
  }
}

function connectBridge() {
  if (bridge.socket && (bridge.socket.readyState === 0 || bridge.socket.readyState === 1)) return;
  bridge.conn = "connecting"; updateAgentStatus();
  let s;
  try { s = root.createServerSocket(); } catch (e) { bridge.conn = "error"; updateAgentStatus(); return; }
  bridge.socket = s;
  s.addEventListener("open", () => {
    bridge.conn = "online"; bridge.nextRetry = 1500;
    try { s.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "hello" })); } catch (e) {}
    if (bridge.probeSrc) { try { publish({ t: "probe:set", src: bridge.probeSrc, by: "client" }); } catch (e) {} }
    updateAgentStatus(); renderAgent();
  });
  s.addEventListener("message", (e) => { let m; try { m = JSON.parse(e.data); } catch (x) { return; } handleBridgeMessage(m); });
  s.addEventListener("close", (e) => {
    bridge.socket = null;
    bridge.conn = (e && e.code === 4403) ? "blocked" : "offline";
    updateAgentStatus(); renderAgent();
    if (e && e.code === 4403) return;
    bridge.nextRetry = Math.min((bridge.nextRetry || 1500) * 2, 15000);
    setTimeout(connectBridge, bridge.nextRetry + Math.random() * 500);
  });
}

/* ---------- chat surface (OffscreenCanvas) ---------- */
let agentMsgN = 0;
/* Thought traces: the provider hides its thinking, so every generation — and
   every explicit thought — is saved through the verified pipeline: pgrep
   proves the runner worker is live, the worker normalizes + digests the entry
   off-thread via the Function constructor, the full entry persists in kv, and
   a digest line goes to the socket journal (server slots are 320B, so the
   journal carries excerpt + digest only). */
async function saveThought(text, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  const kind = String(opts.kind || "note").slice(0, 24);
  const by = String(opts.by || "ai-helper").slice(0, 24);
  let pgrepN = -1;
  try { pgrepN = processList().length; } catch (e) {}
  const raw = { kind: kind, by: by, text: String(text == null ? "" : text), at: Date.now(), pgrep: pgrepN };
  let norm = null, digest = "", ms = 0, via = "worker";
  try {
    await ensureAgent();
    const r = await runnerRun("trace", { entry: raw });
    norm = r.result.entry; digest = r.result.digest; ms = r.result.ms;
  } catch (e) {
    via = "main";
    try {
      norm = new Function("e", "return { kind: String(e.kind).slice(0,24), by: String(e.by).slice(0,24), text: String(e.text).slice(0,2000), at: +e.at || Date.now(), pgrep: e.pgrep|0 };")(raw);
    } catch (e2) { norm = { kind: kind, by: by, text: raw.text.slice(0, 2000), at: raw.at, pgrep: pgrepN }; }
    digest = fnv1a(norm.kind + "|" + norm.by + "|" + norm.text);
  }
  const entry = Object.assign({}, norm, { id: "th" + Date.now().toString(36), digest: digest, via: via, ms: ms });
  try {
    const list = (await sGet("thought-traces", [])) || [];
    list.push(entry);
    while (list.length > 200) list.shift();
    await sSet("thought-traces", list);
  } catch (e) {}
  publish({ t: "say", by: "ai-helper", text: "trace " + entry.id + " [" + entry.kind + "] " + digest + " pgrep=" + pgrepN + " via=" + via + " :: " + String(entry.text).slice(0, 150), cid: entry.id });
  try {
    if (window.__aiThink) window.__aiThink.log("build", "[" + entry.kind + " " + digest + " pgrep=" + pgrepN + "] " + String(entry.text).slice(0, 300), { source: "bridge" });
  } catch (e) {}
  return entry;
}
function agentSay(text, opts) {
  const by = (opts && opts.by) || "ai-helper";
  const entry = { by: by, text: String(text), at: Date.now(), cid: "c" + (++agentMsgN) + "-" + Date.now().toString(36) };
  bridge.chat.push(entry);
  renderAgent();
  try {
    if ((by === "ai" || by === "ai-helper") && window.__aiThink) window.__aiThink.log("build", "[" + by + "] " + String(text).slice(0, 300), { source: by });
  } catch (e) {}
  publish({ t: "say", by: by, text: entry.text, cid: entry.cid });
  return entry;
}

async function agentAsk(text) {
  const q = String(text || "").trim();
  if (!q) return null;
  agentSay(q, { by: "user" });
  bridge.streaming = { text: "" };
  renderAgent();
  const history = bridge.chat.filter((c) => c.by === "user" || c.by === "ai" || c.by === "ai-helper").slice(-12)
    .map((c) => (c.by === "user" ? "User: " : (c.by === "ai-helper" ? "AI-helper: " : "Agent: ")) + c.text);
  const instruction = "You are the agent inside a canvas code editor. Reply briefly, in plain text, to the last message.\n<CHAT>\n" + history.join("\n") + "\n</CHAT>\nTASK: Write the next reply as 'Agent:'.";
  try {
    const res = await root.aiText({ instruction: instruction, startWith: "Agent:", stopSequences: ["\nUser:"], onChunk: (d) => { bridge.streaming = { text: String(d.fullTextSoFar || "").replace(/^Agent:\s*/, "") }; renderAgent(); } });
    const full = String(res.text || "").replace(/^Agent:\s*/, "").trim();
    bridge.streaming = null;
    agentSay(full, { by: "ai" });

function stripCodeNoise(line) {
  return line
    .replace(/(["'`])(?:\\.|(?!\1)[^\\])*\1/g, '""')
    .replace(/\/\/.*$/, "")
    .replace(/\/\*.*?\*\//g, "");
}
function reindentBraces(text, size) {
  const unit = " ".repeat(size || 2);
  const out = [];
  let depth = 0;
  for (const raw of text.split("\n")) {
    const line = raw.trim();
    if (!line) { out.push(""); continue; }
    const s = stripCodeNoise(line);
    const leadingCloser = /^[}\])]/.test(s);
    if (leadingCloser) depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
    out.push(unit.repeat(depth) + line);
    let opens = 0, closes = 0;
    for (const ch of s) { if (ch === "{" || ch === "[") opens++; else if (ch === "}" || ch === "]") closes++; }
    if (leadingCloser) closes = Math.max(0, closes - 1);
    depth = Math.max(0, depth + opens - closes);
  }
  return out.join("\n");
}
const HTML_VOID = /^(area|base|br|col|embed|hr|img|input|link|meta|param|source|track|wbr)$/i;
function reindentHTML(text, size) {
  const unit = " ".repeat(size || 2);
  const out = [];
  let depth = 0;
  for (const raw of text.split("\n")) {
    const line = raw.trim();
    if (!line) { out.push(""); continue; }
    const startsClose = /^<\//.test(line);
    out.push(unit.repeat(startsClose ? Math.max(0, depth - 1) : depth) + line);
    const tags = line.match(/<\/?[a-zA-Z][\w:-]*\b[^>]*?>/g) || [];
    let delta = 0;
    for (const t of tags) {
      const m = t.match(/^<\s*(\/?)\s*([a-zA-Z][\w:-]*)/);
      if (!m) continue;
      const name = m[2];
      if (HTML_VOID.test(name)) continue;
      if (/\/>$/.test(t.trim())) continue;
      delta += m[1] === "/" ? -1 : 1;
    }
    depth = Math.max(0, depth + delta);
  }
  return out.join("\n");
}

/* A dragged position persists in localStorage — after a viewport shrink (short
   preview pane, phone rotation) it can end up below the fold with no way to
   grab it back. Clamp it into view on every restyle + window resize. */
function clampThinking() {
  const d = document.querySelector('[data-ai-thinking-dock="build"]');
  if (!d || d.style.display === "none") return;
  try {
    const r = d.getBoundingClientRect();
    let x = r.left, y = r.top;
    if (isNaN(x) || isNaN(y)) return;
    x = Math.max(-r.width + 90, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 90, x));
    y = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 50, y));
    if (Math.abs(x - r.left) > 1 || Math.abs(y - r.top) > 1) {
      d.style.left = x + "px";
      d.style.top = y + "px";
      d.style.right = "auto";
      d.style.bottom = "auto";
